claim_updates.reason: Frozen decision_rule mandates MEASUREMENT_INVALID because both blocking measurement_validity conditions fail: (1) locatableSample cap still present in MEASURE_JS (line 89, research/experiments/EXP-INTEL-34718481334/measure_fullpage_yield.py) — all 7 tasks capped at 20 samples vs 21-82 locatable elements; (2) canonical 3-definition analysis script not committed at any repo path. The experiment's central question (full-DOM enumeration) was untestable: no full-DOM data exists. The 'full' side is the same non-locatable tag-count estimator already ruled invalid (audit V1, EXP-INTEL-35124660457). Proxy C1/C2 values (ordering changed, null exceeds observed) are computed on an inflated estimator (4-7x overcount) and on a null model that is not reproducible from committed artifacts (audit V5). The spec.json falsifier/null_control and decision_rule contain a semantic contradiction on C2 direction (audit V4) that is unresolved but immaterial since measurement validity fails first. The ISOLATED-A-LINK stored bug (byte-identical to DEF-FULL-MAP) is confirmed (audit V9) and corrected a-only ordering_changed=False. Infrastructure failure is not a scientific negative; the FALSIFIED verdict from EXP-INTEL-35112013458 is neither confirmed nor overturned.

next_question: After the runtime lane removes the first-20 locatableSample cap and a canonical analysis script (3-definition per-role filtering, cart_1 dedup, float scaling) is committed, does full DOM enumeration confirm that the a→link-inclusive page-type ordering changes between truncated and full-DOM, and does the null-model pairwise agreement exceed chance on full-DOM data?
reason: MEASUREMENT_INVALID: two independent blocking dependencies prevent any valid measurement. (1) Substrate: MEASURE_JS still contains 'if (locatableSample.length < 20)' at line 89; all 8 valid measurements have locatable_elements 21-82 but sample_len=20, discarding 5-76% of interactive elements per task (audit V1_SUBSTRATE_CAP_STILL_PRESENT, severity critical). (2) Code: no canonical 3-definition analysis script exists at HEAD; the proxy reconstruction is not an audited artifact (audit V2_CANONICAL_SCRIPT_MISSING, severity critical). Full DOM was never measured: the 'full' count estimate is byte-identical to stored EXP-INTEL-35124660457 values (full_count 454.1 for listing_clothing-shoes-jewelry) using the same tag-count estimator already ruled non-valid (audit V3_FULL_DOM_NEVER_MEASURED). The null model M4 values are not reproducible from committed artifacts (auditor seed sweep 0-1999 for numpy RandomState and default_rng never hit producer's 0.40004004004004; audit V5_NULL_MODEL_NOT_REPRODUCED). The spec's C2 direction is internally contradictory (audit V4): falsifier says null > observed means FALSIFIED, but decision_rule maps null >= observed to SURVIVES. These contradictions are immaterial under MEASUREMENT_INVALID but must be resolved before any re-run. The experiment adds no valid evidence to the C-MEAS-VALID claim chain. The blocking dependencies (runtime cap removal + canonical script commit) remain unchanged from the parent handoff.
